placements.note: Alarm hall to formula room; opens with level 14. Cells (8..9, 3..5).
Glass bridge head: 2x2 cells (15..16, 6..7). Extends with level 12.
Return walkway to Mira's chute: 2x2 cells (10..11, 6..7). Extends with level 12.
Relay room door; opens when levels 12 to 15 are complete. Cells (26..27, 5..7).
Footprint (14..19, 10..13). The four atlas lamps land on (12,10), (12,12), (13,13), (20,13).
Mail chute housing (shared cabinet piece); Mira stands at (12,9).

elevator_closed.purpose: Systems arrival elevator, closed doors. Same set as Orientation's elevator_closed/_half/_open recoloured to the Systems ramps; footprint stays blocked in every state because the player never walks in.

elevator_half.purpose: Systems arrival elevator, half doors. Same set as Orientation's elevator_closed/_half/_open recoloured to the Systems ramps; footprint stays blocked in every state because the player never walks in.

elevator_open.purpose: Systems arrival elevator, open doors. Same set as Orientation's elevator_closed/_half/_open recoloured to the Systems ramps; footprint stays blocked in every state because the player never walks in.

elevator_call_panel.purpose: Call panel beside the arrival elevator (Orientation prop name, Systems ramps).

routing_node_dark.purpose: One of ten routing-node lamps on the payroll wing wall, dark.

routing_node_lit.purpose: The same node lit mint with a pale head.

refund_ledger_charge.purpose: Inset calculator and ledger display showing the refund as a charge, with orange sign markers.

refund_ledger_refund.purpose: The same display after the sign flips: refund, in green, markers calm.

alarm_board_blank.purpose: Alarm board with six lost labels: six pictogram slots blank, two pairs of lights look identical.

alarm_board_labeled_1.purpose: Alarm board with 1 of 6 pictograms restored; each restored light takes its own hue.

alarm_board_labeled_2.purpose: Alarm board with 2 of 6 pictograms restored; each restored light takes its own hue.

alarm_board_labeled_3.purpose: Alarm board with 3 of 6 pictograms restored; each restored light takes its own hue.

alarm_board_labeled_4.purpose: Alarm board with 4 of 6 pictograms restored; each restored light takes its own hue.

alarm_board_labeled_5.purpose: Alarm board with 5 of 6 pictograms restored; each restored light takes its own hue.

alarm_board_labeled_6.purpose: Alarm board with 6 of 6 pictograms restored; each restored light takes its own hue.

formula_wall_dim.purpose: Large formula wall, flattened into one unreadable line, dim.

formula_wall_clause_1.purpose: Formula wall with clauses 1..1 valid and lit; connected parts glow mint.

formula_wall_clause_2.purpose: Formula wall with clauses 1..2 valid and lit; connected parts glow mint.

formula_wall_clause_3.purpose: Formula wall with clauses 1..3 valid and lit; connected parts glow mint.

formula_wall_clause_4.purpose: Formula wall with clauses 1..4 valid and lit; connected parts glow mint.

formula_wall_clause_5.purpose: Formula wall with clauses 1..5 valid and lit; connected parts glow mint.

formula_wall_clause_6.purpose: Formula wall with clauses 1..6 valid and lit; connected parts glow mint.

formula_wall_lit.purpose: Formula wall fully valid and lit; the detour-score term is readable.

bridge_span_retracted.purpose: Glass bridge span before level 12: retracted, closed by two porcelain shutter plates with an orange hazard edge. Used twice (bridge and return walkway).

bridge_span_extended.purpose: The span extended: 2x2 cells of the existing bridge_deck tile with glass rails already placed beside it. Used twice (bridge and return walkway).

bridge_shutter_closed.purpose: Louvred shutter band across the formula room's bridge head, closed: no sight line to the routing machine.

bridge_shutter_open.purpose: The shutter drawn up: clear glass, the machine visible from the formula room.

folding_stool_folded.purpose: Folding stool folded against the wall (Hal crouches beside it).

folding_stool_open.purpose: Folding stool open; Hal sits on it after level 13. Footprint walkable because Hal's cell is the stool cell.

artifact_id_envelope.purpose: ID envelope lying on the payroll ID trays: addressed to a department that no longer exists.

artifact_alarm_strip.purpose: Alarm strip tucked in the alarm-hall rack: old alert names with an extra department.

artifact_scoring_proof.purpose: Scoring proof pinned to the formula-room shelf: a longer route earned a higher engagement total.

artifact_original_routing_diagram.purpose: Original routing diagram rolled on the relay cabinet, signed by several employees rather than Pace.

gates.visible_change: The glass bridge extends: two shutter plates retract and the deck runs from the hub's north strip to the formula room.
gates.locked_hint: Sign by the bridge head: the span extends after Payroll IDs (level 12).

gates.visible_change: The return walkway extends from the formula room's west end down to Mira's chute.
gates.locked_hint: Visible through the glass: the walkway lands beside Mira's chute.

gates.visible_change: The alarm hall's maintenance door slides aside and opens a direct path to the formula room.
gates.locked_hint: The door's sign plate shows the alarm board still has unlabeled alerts.

gates.visible_change: The relay room door opens once all three branch conduits are lit; the glass beside it already shows the machine.
gates.locked_hint: The door's sign plate shows three conduit families, one lit per finished branch.

zones.note: Service floor around the routing machine (14..19, 10..13); elevator at the south edge.
North-east gallery leading to the relay door.
East branch: cobalt conduit through the wall gap to the payroll wing.
Short west branch to the refund ledger room.
West branch: mint conduit along row 14 into the alarm hall.
Glass bridge to the formula room.
Return walkway from the formula room to Mira's chute.
Relay door in wall B; glass either side.

interactions.label: Hal at the routing machine (level 13 briefing)
Mira at the mail chute: Payroll Run
Mira in the relay room: Glyph Dispatch
Chair with a second shadow (optional repair)
Maintenance door to the formula room
Pace sign: the glass bridge extends after Payroll IDs
Relay card desk A: cobalt, numbers
Relay card desk B: orange, expression
Relay card desk C: mint, typo
Relay review console: final mixed recall
False panel: the Night Shift elevator stop

npcs.note: One Hal moves between rooms; each state sets pose and cell together (npc_state). Crouched repair, seated on the stool and the false-panel pull are not drawn yet: hal_interact_e, hal_idle_s and hal_interact_n stand in (NEEDS_ART.md).
At the chute until level 16 completes, then in the relay room (Glyph Dispatch); she offers both routes there.
Typing at the ID check desk; idle offset is random per worker, not synchronised.
Walks a loop on the hub's south-east floor; independent clock because Orientation level 06 is long complete.

main.label: Elevator to the payroll keypad: north up the spine, east along the band and through the payroll gap
Payroll wing to the refund ledger: back through the gap, west along row 18 and the ledger branch
Ledger room to the alarm label desk: back out the ledger branch, north along the west strip, through the alarm gap
Alarm hall to the formula console: through the hall and the maintenance door (open after 14) to the formula room
Formula room to the relay review console: over the glass bridge, along the north strip, up the gallery and through the relay door

backtrack.label: Formula room back to Mira's chute by the return walkway
Quiet Alarm panel in the alarm hall straight to the formula room through the maintenance door
Relay room back to the elevator: gallery, hub east strip, spine, arrival cell

spawns.when: arriving by the Systems elevator stop
returning through the false panel from Night Shift (after level 16)

notes: Collision is the initial state: gate cells start blocked and the validator opens each gate for later levels.

Walls: north wall rows 0-1; east wall x 36-37; wall A (x 8-9) separates alarm hall and ledger room from hub and formula room; wall B (x 26-27) separates gallery and hub from relay room and payroll wing; west edge and south row are partitions.
